data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental stag weekend cost breakdown 2035? You have come to the right place. Whether you are after a budget-friendly two-hour cruise or a full-day luxury charter with a jet ski, our fleet in Puerto Banús offers transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Below, we break down every option so you can plan your budget with confidence.

Why Choose a Boat for Your Stag Weekend?

A boat charter in Marbella turns a standard stag do into an unforgettable experience. You get private access to the Costa del Sol’s best swimming spots – Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the coves near Cabopino – without the crowds. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance, so you can focus on celebrating.

Tier A: Affordable Stag Boat Rentals (€749–€2,299)

Our Tier A boats – the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Perfect for smaller stag groups on a tighter budget. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include all standard inclusions: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. For a 2-hour trip, that is under €85 per person for a group of 9 – exceptional value for a private charter.

Tier B: Luxury Stag Charters with Jet Ski (from €4,719)

For groups wanting more space and a thrill, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) and its grey variant are available from €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. This price includes a free jet ski – ideal for stag parties that want to combine cruising with water sports. At €393 per person for a group of 12, it is a premium experience that still works out cost-effective when split.

Other Boats: Custom Quotes for Larger Groups

If your stag group demands something bigger – like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Simply tell us your group size, preferred date, and duration, and we will send a tailored quote within hours. These boats are perfect for those wanting the ultimate luxury experience.

What’s Included (and What’s Not)

  • Included: Licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, 21% IVA.
  • Not included: Extra food, premium spirits, skipper tip (optional, 10–15% customary).
  • Pro tip: Bring your own cooler with spirits or order a catering platter from local delis in Puerto Banús – many deliver to the marina.

Example Budget Breakdown for a Stag Weekend

When to Book & How to Secure Your Boat

Peak stag season runs June–September. For the best availability, book 4–8 weeks in advance. We recommend contacting us via Boat Rental Marbella to check availability and get a confirmed quote. For Tier A boats, a 50% deposit secures the booking; for Tier B and custom quotes, terms are agreed upon individually.

Frequently asked questions

What is the cheapest boat for a stag weekend in Marbella?

The most affordable option is a Tier A boat like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, starting at €749 for 2 hours and going up to €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT – no surprises.

Does the Mangusta 80 really include a free jet ski?

Yes, the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) charter at €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours includes a jet ski at no extra cost. Perfect for stag groups wanting adrenaline alongside luxury cruising.

What is included in the charter price?

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees – just show up with your group.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring extra food and premium drinks. The boat provides a standard drinks package, but many stag groups add a cooler with spirits or a barbecue platter from local caterers.

How many people can fit on a boat for a stag do?

Boats range from 5 passengers (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) up to 12 passengers (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Ferretti 94). For a typical stag group of 8–12, the Azimut 58 or Mangusta 80 are popular choices.

Do I need to tip the skipper?

Tipping is optional but appreciated – 10–15% of the charter fee is customary if the service is good. It is not included in the price, so budget an extra €75–€230 depending on your charter tier.

What is the best time of year for a stag boat party?

June through September offers the best weather – 28–32°C air temp, sea temp 24–26°C, and long daylight hours. Book 4–8 weeks ahead for peak dates to secure your preferred boat.

How do I book a boat not listed with set prices?

For boats like the Ferretti 94, Pershing 46, or Canados 86, pricing is on request. Simply message us on WhatsApp with your dates, group size, and preferred duration, and we will send a tailored quote within hours.
